full_judgment: 7. Learned Subordinate Judge on consideration of the evidence on record, by judgment and decree dated 28-4-1988 dismissed Partition Suit No.63 of 1970 against defendant No.3 with costs. Other Suit No.7 of 1972 was decreed. The learned Subordinate Judge ordered that the plaintiff of this suit by evicting the defendants from the suit premises would get khas possession of the same and directed for recovery of Taka 140 from the defendants and for payment of Taka 10 per day from 1-9-1970 till 28-4-1988. The learned Subordinate Judge dismissed Money Suit No.13 of 1972.
